title: The Ember of Ashvale Revisited
author: L. M. Vasquez
blurb: Isandro Oyelaran, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
